Coverage is held at Partial rather than Specced because neither of this package's own test routes executes a case: test:unit skips all 21 declared cases under Node (skipInNode) and test:browser completes 0 tests because the shared abstract suite calls the Jest global beforeAll under mocha, both measured 2026-10-01 and confirmed independently 2026-10-04. Holding at Partial also reflects the recorded thresholds: the partial_to_specced rule requires a clean drift record across touching PRs, and independent validation has so far returned blocked. Requiring an executing verification route before promotion is a recommendation from this assessment, not a threshold in coverage_status_definitions.

storage-adapter-local-storage-sdk.summary: Published npm package @webex/storage-adapter-local-storage. Its ecosystem-native declaration is package.json (main dist/index.js, devMain src/index.js); the implementation is src/index.js, which default-exports the StorageAdapterLocalStorage class. The constructor takes a basekey and bind(namespace, options) resolves a bound store exposing get, put, del, and clear. The package ships no .d.ts or API report, so package.json is the only machine-readable declaration.

local-storage-bounded-document.summary: At-rest JSON document written to localStorage under the constructor basekey, shaped {namespace: {key: value}}. Read by _getRawData/_load and written by _save. It survives page reloads and releases, and the code carries no version field, no migration step, and no schema validation. Whether cross-release readability is a committed promise is an unresolved owner decision recorded in src/docs/README.md; this entry states current behavior only.

webex-core-store-adapter-interface.summary: The storage-adapter interface the webex-core storage layer calls. WebexStore._getBinding invokes adapter.bind(namespace, {logger}) and then calls get, put, del, and clear on the resolved binding. Owned by @webex/webex-core, outside this SDD root.

spec_sources.notes: Package install/usage reference. Left byte-for-byte unchanged under keep-separate. Known conflict with code: it describes clear() as clearing data for the bound namespace, but src/index.js:77 removes the whole basekey across every namespace. Treat src/docs/README.md as authoritative for behavior.
